description: This source file defines the ResponseEmitter class used in the Slim Framework to handle emitting HTTP responses to clients. It manages sending headers, status line, and response body, with support for chunked responses and connection status handling.

classes.name: ResponseEmitter
classes.description: A class responsible for emitting HTTP responses by sending headers, status line, and body content to the client, with support for chunked transfer and connection status checking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ResponseEmitter instance with an optional response chunk size.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Main method to send the ResponseInterface object to the client, including headers, status, and body.

methods.name: emitHeaders
methods.description: Sends all headers from the ResponseInterface to the client.

methods.name: emitStatusLine
methods.description: Sends the HTTP status line to the client.

methods.name: emitBody
methods.description: Sends the response body in chunks, handling seekable streams and connection status.

methods.name: isResponseEmpty
methods.description: Determines if the response is considered empty based on status code or body content.
